# Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day

 2024-05-21

Vendor:[Peach Garden Restaurant](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/109/peach-garden-chinese-restaurant)

Peach Garden 桃苑 is a renowned restaurant chain in Singapore known for its Cantonese cuisine. It has six outlets across the island, including in shopping malls and standalone locations. Here are some key points about Peach Garden and why couples should consider them for their big day:

### Venues for any theme your heart desires

Peach Garden 桃苑 has 4 out of 6 Peach Garden outlets available for weddings: The Heeren, OCBC Centre, Thomson Plaza & The Metropolis. All outlets have different themes and capacities.

Firstly, amidst the hustle and bustle of Orchard lies Peach Garden @ The Heeren. The Heeren is a haven of refined elegance and has a maximum capacity of 200 people. The spacious venue coupled with the cream-coloured theme, conveys a touch of gracefulness that is guaranteed to make any couples’ special day remain eternally stylish. The background with an overview of Orchard road or its Main Hall that features an ocean-like theme, providing a beautiful backdrop for wedding photos. Overall, The Heeren embodies a harmonious blend of modernity and elegance, where timeless principles meet contemporary innovation to create a refined and sophisticated aesthetic and experience.

![Image 5: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134410_73990.jpg)

_Peach Garden @ The Heeren_

Secondly, Peach Garden @ OCBC Centre has a capacity of 360 people, the most among Peach Garden’s venues – which can accommodate all of the guests comfortably. Situated on the heights of Level 33, it is guaranteed to provide a stunning view and breath-taking atmosphere to elevate your wedding. This prime location provides spectacular sights through the glass walls, and overlooks the Singapore River, Esplanade and Singapore Flyers. To add, the natural light filtering in makes the ballroom the best choice for picturesque shots. All in all, the location at OCBC Centre is certainly unique as it provides many beautiful scenes of the Singapore skyline from its heights.

![Image 6: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134501_31333.jpg)

_Peach Garden @ OCBC Centre_

The third venue is located in Peach Garden @ Thomson Plaza, and it can accommodate up to 300 guests. Embodying a theme of Timeless Tradition, this venue is perfect for couples looking to host weddings in favour of their family, who might prefer a more traditional venue and vibe. At Thomson Plaza, the traditional decorations and customs are not tacky, but instead convey a deep sense of Chinese culture and heritage. The little dashes of red across the venue in the forms of flower bouquets, cutlery to napkins adheres closely to Chinese tradition and provides for a meaningful wedding day that pays homage to one's culture and heritage.

![Image 7: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134534_36255.jpg)

_Peach Garden @ Thomson Plaza_

Last but not least, Peach Garden @ The Metropolis has a theme of Sunlit Simplicity and can host up to 120 guests. Although the smallest venue among all, it provides a cosy ambience for the wedding. With its floor-to-ceiling glass panels and abundant natural sunlight, this venue is perfect for capturing beautiful wedding luncheon photos, leaving couples with beautiful pictures that transcends their special day.

![Image 8: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134619_43353.jpg)

_Peach Garden @ The Metropolis_

### Mouth-watering cuisine, bespoke creations

Peach Garden offers the most exquisite Cantonese dishes, bound to please the young and old. Pique your taste buds with signature dishes like Suckling Pig Combination Platter, Roasted Golden Suckling Pig, Stewed Ee-fu Noodle with Baby Lobster, Spring Onion and Ginger. Beyond being skilled in whipping up Cantonese delights, Peach Garden can even tailor a personalised wedding menu exclusively for your special day!

![Image 9: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134824_45817.jpg)

_Featuring the Suckling Pig Platter and Tiger King Prawn with Superior Soya Sauce_

### Tailor-made packages, worthwhile pricings

Peach Garden’s attention to detail doesn’t just stop at venues and food – they have a dedicated team ready to assist couples throughout the planning process, ensuring a seamless and personalised experience. Of course, there is also flexibility in accommodating various budget levels so all couples can have a wedding day within their financial means. Although early bookings are recommended, Peach Garden is flexible enough to accommodate events with as little as 1-2 month’s notice if possible! This certainly eases the burden on stressed out couples rushing to plan their wedding.

Despite Peach Garden’s notable brand, they still offer pricing that remains value for money without compromising the quality of their food and services. Couples can enjoy a top-tier wedding experience without breaking the bank; from $1038++ per table onwards (for Packages), Peach Garden is also able to customise bespoke packages for smaller scale events such as solemnization or smaller wedding groups. The new offering for Solemnization: the Traditional Push Cart Dim Sum is starting from $88++ per person (minimum 3 tables). This menu features a selection of our meticulously crafted signature dim sum, including Steamed Fresh Prawn Dumpling, Steamed Siew Mai with Fish Roe, Deep-fried Bean Skin Roll with Seaweed, and more. Each meal is complemented with a main course and dessert for a memorable dining experience.

### Look no further than Peach Garden for your dream wedding

Peach Garden ensures that every wedding and its details is meticulously attended to, offering the couples a fuss-free and seamless experience. They also offer elegant settings with a variety of exquisite decor options to choose from, making sure that the couple’s special day is genuinely memorable. With them, they are able to cherish their special moment without any concerns about the wedding flow.

For more information on weddings at Peach Garden, simply contact their team at [banquet@peachgarden.com.sg](mailto:banquet@peachgarden.com.sg) or at 6252 9833 and be on your way to a memorable wedding!

# 4 Steps to a Picture-Perfect Smile for Your Wedding Photos

 2023-01-31

![Image 5: 4 Steps to a Picture-Perfect Smile for Your Wedding Photos](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230130/20230130161409_80160.jpg)

A wedding is one of the most significant occasions in a couple’s life. As such, it’s essential to document every special moment of the event. For the groom and the bride, having amazing photos of them together is a must, as they’ll serve as souvenirs from one of the most notable events in their life. In [wedding photography packages](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/14/wedding-photography "Wedding Photography Packages, Wedding Photography Packages Singapore")are in demand for this exact reason.

Everyone wishes to have professional and beautiful shots of their wedding day. However, because a wedding can be nerve-wracking, some might find it challenging to pose for pictures with a stunning smile. If you think you’re one of these people, this article might be of help to you! Here are some simple yet effective tips on how to have a picture-perfect smile for your wedding day photos.

### 1.Don’t Look at the Camera Directly

Although this may sound counterproductive, ignoring the camera is one of the most effective tips for having a beautiful smile on your wedding day. Whether you believe it or not, facing the camera lens straight-on is the most unflattering angle for many people. So, look around the camera lens instead of looking right at it. You may also try looking at something in your hand or someone next to you.

### 2. Wear a Moist and Creamy Lipstick

On your big day, consider wearing a lip gloss or lipstick that has some moisture and is creamy. A sticky lip gloss or dry lipstick will make it more difficult for your lips to easily slide over your teeth when you smile. If you think your lipstick is too dry, try slightly licking your lips between photos.

### 3.Have Your Teeth Professional Cleaned and Whitened

Perfect smiles begin with clean and white teeth. If it’s time for your yearly teeth cleaning, be sure to schedule an appointment before your wedding day. If you particularly notice some stains on your teeth, it’s highly advised to have them professionally whitened. Having clean and white teeth is key to achieving a bright smile for your wedding photos.

### 4. Practice, Practice, Practice

Smiling is just like any other activity—if you wish to do it perfectly, you must practice! Days before your wedding, stand in front of a mirror and practice your smile. Try various angles to be able to find your best side. For instance, try tilting your head slightly or having your hair in a different arrangement than usual to see how it changes your face when you smile. Indeed, as the classic saying goes, _“Practice makes perfect.”_ The same thing is true for your smile.

Conclusion

# Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall

 2025-03-04

![Image 5: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111414_25711.jpg)

Have you heard? Couples who desire atypical or unique wedding spots are turning their gaze skyward — specifically to the rooftop of Grand Park City Hall. Here, among wrought iron domes and gentle fountains, urban weddings take on an unexpected botanical twist. It's where "I do" comes with a view and wedding stress checks out before you do.

For those who believe marriage should start on a high note, this skyward sanctuary might just be your match made in heaven — or at least, several stories closer to it. Read on for more.

### A Garden in the Sky

Tucked away from the hustle and bustle of Singapore's central business district lies a hidden gem for couples seeking a memorable wedding venue. Grand Park City Hall offers not one, but two distinctive spaces that transform wedding dreams into reality.

![Image 6: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111455_89760.jpg)

The crown jewel of this urban retreat is undoubtedly the Rooftop Sky Garden. Perched at the building's summit, this outdoor venue draws inspiration from the surrounding nature and neoclassical architecture of Singapore's historic Civic District. The wrought iron dome structure creates a stunning focal point, while gentle water fountains provide a soothing soundtrack to your ceremony; one couldn’t ask for a more perfect backdrop for rustic outdoor garden weddings and intimate solemnisations.

![Image 7: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111511_91323.jpg)

![Image 8: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111521_48712.jpg)

For couples concerned about capacity, the Rooftop Sky Garden comfortably accommodates up to 120 guests for ceremonies and 80 for receptions, making it ideal for those who prefer quality time with a select gathering rather than an overwhelming crowd.

### Fine Dining Excellence

![Image 9: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111543_36882.jpg)

For indoor celebrations, Tablescape Restaurant on Level 3 presents an equally impressive option. Widely regarded as one of the finest dining establishments in Singapore's CBD, Tablescape transports guests to an era when restaurant dining was a truly special occasion.

![Image 10: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111556_86493.jpg)

![Image 11: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111610_45371.jpg)

The restaurant's interior showcases neoclassical beauty with meticulous attention to detail, creating an atmosphere of refined elegance. Here, up to 120 guests can enjoy a reception featuring impeccable table service and classic dishes reimagined with contemporary flair.

Seamless Planning Support

Understanding that wedding planning can be overwhelming, Grand Park City Hall offers dedicated support to ensure a stress-free experience. Each couple is assigned a designated Event Services Planner who handles pre-event logistics and coordinates all details, ensuring everything runs smoothly on the big day.

### The Grand Park Promise

![Image 12: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111655_71931.jpg)

Wedding dates are precious, and securing your preferred venue is paramount. Grand Park City Hall recommends that couples place their deposit as soon as they finalise their date. With packages starting from $178++ to $198++ per person, Grand Park City Hall offers competitive pricing for a premium wedding experience in a central Singapore location.

For couples seeking a wedding venue that balances urban convenience with natural beauty, historical character with modern amenities, and intimate atmosphere with generous capacity, **Grand Park City Hall** stands ready to host your celebration of love.

# Booking A Wedding Room Block: Everything You Need To Know

 2024-10-31

![Image 5: Booking A Wedding Room Block: Everything You Need To Know](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241018/20241018182740_72142.jpg)

There’s a lot that goes into planning a great wedding experience, and ensuring your guests are well taken care of makes up a big part of it. This is especially important if you’re getting hitched somewhere that attendees aren’t too familiar with and will thus need help finding a convenient and comfortable place to rest. While you could always choose to play travel agent for all your loved ones, there’s a much better way to go about this task, and this is through wedding room blocks. Whether you’re having a local or destination wedding, this guide should prove useful in clarifying one of the key aspects of your [wedding planning checklist](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/wedding-tools "Wedding Planning Checklist, Wedding Planning Checklist Singapore").

### What are wedding room blocks?

![Image 6: Booking A Wedding Room Block: Everything You Need To Know](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241018/20241018182831_51900.jpg)

A wedding room block is a reservation of a group of rooms located close to or adjacent to one another in a hotel or other venue. The wedding planner or the couple themselves are typically the ones responsible for reserving the block and pre-negotiating the rates. It then falls on the guests to book and pay for their individual rooms.

Utilising room blocks is highly recommended as it saves your guests time and money while attending your special day. Moreover, having them reside all in one place allows the wedding planner to quickly address any issues they may run into during the weekend of the wedding. Beyond these, wedding room blocks provide plenty of other benefits, such as:

*    Provide guests with a home base to rest at the end of the night. 
*    Seamless organisation of transport to and from the wedding venue(s). 
*    Allows guests to socialise and bond outside of wedding events. 
*    Easier tracking of attendees by checking which guests successfully booked a room. 
*    Ensure the timely arrival of guests and secure their attendance without unnecessary hiccups. 

Last but not least, booking a wedding room block may even come with some perks for the couple if they’re staying in the same hotel, such as getting their room for free or receiving an upgrade to their current accommodations.

### Pro tips to simplify your wedding room block booking

![Image 7: Booking A Wedding Room Block: Everything You Need To Know](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241018/20241018183239_90160.jpg)

Keep these expert tips in mind once you’re ready to get started with the booking process.

### 1. Get to know the different types of room blocks

Room blocks come in two main categories: courtesy and guaranteed blocks. The former option features a no-commitment policy and involves anywhere between 10 to 20 rooms that a hotel sets aside for your guests until a specific cut-off date. The key advantage of these blocks is that you’re not financially responsible if some or none of them get booked. There is a tradeoff, however, which is that the hotel may release the unbooked rooms 30 to 60 days before the date to other guests, hence the importance of securing them early.

This is the opposite for the latter type, as the room blocks become closed or confirmed and generally require a contract that includes penalties or additional fees for cancellations. The contract also stipulates how much of the block must be booked, with the average being at least 90%. If the confirmed bookings don’t reach that threshold, the client will have to pay for the remaining rooms.

### 2.Book as soon as possible

Many hotels open up room blocks a year in advance. Therefore, it’s best to get in touch with multiple hotels the moment you confirm your wedding date and have found an [affordable wedding venue](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/top-5-affordable-wedding-venues-in-singapore-to-consider "Affordable Wedding Venues, Affordable Wedding Venues Singapore"). The earlier you are, the better your odds of locking in a lower rate.

### 3.Get an estimate of the number of guests who’ll need accommodations

Having a clear estimate of the attendees who want to use your pre-arranged accommodations saves you the stress of potentially over-filling or under-filling the room block. A Google Form or other polling service should suffice to get everyone’s opinion on this matter.

### 4.Strategise your outreach

When asking a hotel sales representative about their room blocks, take note of the following to get the best rate:

*   **Stay tight-lipped about your budget**Don’t disclose your [wedding budget](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/6-tips-for-a-wedding-budget-that-perfectly-fits-your-big-day "6 Tips for a Wedding Budget That Perfectly Fits Your Big Day")when they ask about it. By saying you’re still figuring things out, you avoid their upselling schemes and can quickly gather information regarding their full range of services offered. 
*   **State your intention about comparing deals**It’s always a good idea to casually let them know that you’re actively reaching out to other places to find the best rate. Ideally, you should mention this right from the start; otherwise, it may come off as a bargaining tactic and reduce your chances of persuading them to give you a good offer.
*   **Price match their competition**Ideally, you should exhaust all possible accommodation options and list down the initial rates and perks of every hotel you reach out to. Checking on more than a few hotels lets you uncover better deals and helps your guests save more money for little effort on your part.

### Key considerations for choosing a hotel for your wedding room blocks

![Image 8: Booking A Wedding Room Block: Everything You Need To Know](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241018/20241018183600_60144.jpg)

When choosing a hotel for your wedding room blocks, keep these factors in mind:

1.   **Hotel size and capacity:**Ensure the hotel has enough rooms to accommodate all your guests. 
2.   **Amenities:**Look for facilities like a gym, pool, and dining options that can enhance your guests' experience. 
3.   **Location:** Choose a hotel close to the wedding venue or local attractions for easy access. 
4.   **Cost:**Check for reasonable room rates and any available discounts for your guests. 
5.   **Extra fees:**Be aware of any extra charges related to the room block, such as service fees or minimum booking requirements. 
6.   **Cancellation policies:**Confirm the hotel’s rules regarding cancellations and refunds to provide your guests with more flexibility. 
7.   **Additional services:** Inquire about services like shuttle transportation or complimentary breakfast that could benefit your guests.

# Choosing the Perfect Bridal Hairstyle: Tips and Inspiration

 2023-07-13

![Image 5: Choosing the Perfect Bridal Hairstyle: Tips and Inspiration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230713/20230713142416_74750.jpg)

Your wedding day is a beautiful and treasured moment, full of meaning and lasting memories. Every aspect, no matter how minor, is extremely important. Among these exquisite details, your bridal hairstyle shines like a luminous gem, deserving of careful consideration. As such, allow us the pleasure of assisting you in discovering the perfect bridal hairstyle with these valuable tips.

### 1. Consider Your Dress and Venue

Take a moment to think about your wedding dress and venue before indulging in visions of your ideal hairstyle. The style and neckline of your dress have an influence over the choice of a suitable hairstyle. For instance, picture an elaborate updo that beautifully complements a strapless gown, or loose waves that harmonise flawlessly with a bohemian-inspired ensemble.

Likewise, allow the ambience of your chosen venue to gently steer your hairstyle selection. Should your vows be exchanged amidst a [flourishing outdoor garden](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/5-things-you-need-to-ready-to-pull-off-an-outdoor-wedding "5 Things You Need To Ready To Pull Off An Outdoor Wedding"), envision a romantic half-up, half-down creation adorned with dainty blooms. Conversely, an elegant chignon or a sleek ponytail might elegantly befit a sophisticated indoor gathering. Allow the overarching ambience of your wedding to serve as your guiding beacon to the perfect hairstyle for your special day!

### 2.Seek Professional Advice

Enlist the guidance of a professional hairstylist once you have envisioned the desired style for your tresses. By scheduling a trial session well in advance of your momentous day, you can openly discuss your ideas and experiment with various hairstyles. A seasoned stylist will be able to provide invaluable insights based on your hair type, length, and texture and assess your facial features, ensuring that the selected style accentuates your innate beauty.

During the trial, don’t hesitate to voice your preferences and address any concerns you may have. After all, transparent communication holds the key to success. Should you plan on adorning your hair with accessories like a veil, tiara, or hairpin, be sure to present them to your stylist. This enables them to seamlessly incorporate these elements into your chosen hairstyle.

### 3. Embrace Your Natural Beauty

When deciding on a bridal hairstyle, remember to celebrate and embrace your inherent beauty. Avoid drastic changes that might make you uncomfortable or veer too far from your personal style. Your wedding day should be an extension of your true essence, exuding confidence and joy.

If you have naturally curly hair, consider embracing its charm with a soft and romantic updo or an artfully loose side braid. For those with straight hair, explore sleek, polished options like a classic bun or an elegant, braided crown. Allow your distinctive features to be accentuated, and grant your chosen hairstyle the privilege of reflecting your vibrant personality, illuminating your essence.

### 4. Draw Inspiration from Various Sources

The world is an abundant source of inspiration. Take advantage of diverse sources to gather ideas relevant to your style. Immerse yourself in the enthralling pages of wedding magazines, the realms of bridal websites, and social media platforms like Pinterest and Instagram. Consider creating a dedicated folder or board to curate and save your favourite looks, ready to be shared with your trusted stylist.

Additionally, draw inspiration from the allure of celebrity weddings and the glamour of red-carpet events. Celebrities often blaze trails with their elegant and sophisticated hairstyles, setting trends that captivate the imagination. Seek out those stars with similar hair types or facial features to your own, unveiling styles that could be a seamless match for your beauty. Adapt these ideas, infusing them with your personal preferences, and fashion a customised look that expresses your individuality.

### 5. Don’t Forget About Hair Care

When preparing for your big day, it’s essential to go beyond mere hairstyle selection and prioritise the care of your precious locks. During the months preceding your wedding, establish a dedicated hair care routine encompassing regular trims, deep conditioning treatments, and minimal heat styling. Nourish your hair from within by maintaining a well-balanced diet and staying well-hydrated. These practices will significantly improve your hair’s overall health and radiant appearance.

### Conclusion

When searching for the perfect bridal hairdo, personal preference, expert advice, and artistic inspiration all intertwine. With these tips and a touch of imagination, you are bound to discover a hairstyle that will highlight your inner brilliance while expressing the essence of a radiant bride.

# What to Discuss With Your Wedding Photographer Beforehand

 2023-03-13

![Image 5: What to Discuss With Your Wedding Photographer Beforehand](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230306/20230306095008_22424.jpg)

Weddings are incomplete without photos. Your wedding photos are essentially there to serve as an incredible memorial to one of the most important days of your life. To make sure that these photos accurately reflect your wedding day and the love you and your partner have for each other, you need to find a photographer whose work matches your style and preferences.

Wedding photography packages are very much popular because they can be trusted to deliver high-quality photos. However, to ensure that your desired photos are achieved, it’s essential to communicate with your photographer about certain matters beforehand.

Along with these [questions you should ask your photographer](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/5-vital-questions-to-ask-your-potential-wedding-photographer "5 Vital Questions To Ask Your Potential Wedding Photographer"), below are some key things you should discuss with them days or weeks before your wedding.

### 1. Shots You Like and Dislike

Weddings are supposed to be a once-in-a-lifetime event. If there’s a specific photo or photos that you desperately want, you should tell your photographer about it before your wedding day. These pictures can be anything — a moment between you and your beloved mother or a shot of you and your partner next to a fountain where the marriage proposal happened.

If the photographer has no idea that these moments are important to you, they won’t be able to capture them. Similarly, you should also tell your photographer about certain shots that you think are cringe or wouldn’t want to be included in your wedding album. For your photographer to get things right, you need to let them know what you like and dislike.

### 2. Timetable for the Wedding Day

Having a clear and well-organised timetable for your wedding day is crucial to ensuring that everything you wish to happen, happens. This includes adding time into your schedule for the formal shots and some peaceful bride-and-groom photos.

When the photographer knows the timetable for your wedding day, they can capture all the moments that you want to be captured. You wouldn’t want to feel stressed, rushed, or miss out on anything meaningful when it comes to your wedding photos.

### 3. Planned Surprises and Quirks

Sometimes, people want their wedding day to be full of surprises to make the occasion more memorable. However, on the part of the wedding photographer, surprises can be missed opportunities.

Hence, if you’re planning to insert some quirks and surprises into your wedding schedule, you should inform your photographer in advance so they wouldn’t miss them. No matter what surprise it is and whoever organises it, it’s essential to let the photographer know.

### 4. Any Unexpected Lighting Elements

While a good photographer should be able to handle unusual lighting situations, it’s still necessary to inform them if you have anything planned. For instance, if you’re planning to hire a DJ and have a dark dance floor, you should let your photographer know.

Learning about these things before the wedding day will enable the photographer to prepare the appropriate equipment necessary for achieving high-quality photos, notwithstanding any lighting oddities.

### Conclusion

There are several different things to discuss with your photographer before your wedding day. Help your photographer make your wedding day smooth and seamless by always being transparent with them. Furthermore, informing your photographer about certain situations is an absolute must if you wish to achieve the most beautiful photos of your wedding.

Blissful Brides Issue 38 delves into the heart of modern weddings as we return to traditional celebrations. Overflowing with expert guidance, engaging narratives, and a trove of resources, this edition aspires to support couples in orchestrating their idyllic day. From trustworthy wedding vendors to enlightening articles on relationship growth, we have it all covered. Enjoy our exclusive glimpse into celebrity nuptials and choose from our carefully curated selections. Let Issue 38 be your compass in designing a wedding that echoes your unique love story.

# Weddings

 The perfect wedding requires an enchanting location and an experienced team to put it together. As the only beachfront resort in Singapore, Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa, Singapore offers a unique location for a Wedding by the Sea.

 Couples who prefer the comfort of a traditional ballroom setting can hold a banquet in one of the two ballrooms. The Horizon Pavilion features floor-to-ceiling windows for a panoramic view of the sea in air-conditioned comfort. Alternatively, you can opt for a memorable sunset solemnization by the waterfront followed by a banquet in the ballroom.

 A team of professional and responsive wedding planners will be with you every step of the way to create a memorable Wedding by the Sea.

# The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love 

 2025-03-11

Vendor:[ALUXE](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/11/jewellery-accessories/detail/1203/aluxe)

![Image 5: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153606_46512.jpg)

Few things capture the essence of love quite like a diamond. For over 40 years, **ALUXE** has been perfecting the art of selecting and crafting these timeless gems, earning its place as Taiwan’s leading wedding jewellery brand. Now, Singaporean couples can experience the same expertise and dedication, with ALUXE’s dazzling collection of diamonds and wedding rings designed to mark life’s most cherished moments.

As one of Taiwan’s largest diamond importers, ALUXE sources directly from the top three diamond-cutting factories worldwide, bypassing unnecessary middlemen. The result? Premium diamonds at competitive prices, ensuring couples get the most brilliance for their budget. With some of the best diamond prices in Singapore, ALUXE ensures couples get maximum brilliance for their budget, making luxury more accessible than ever.

### A Bespoke Experience

![Image 6: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153622_93848.jpg)

Every love story is unique, and the ring that symbolises it should be too. ALUXE offers full customisation with thousands of ring designs, styles, and settings to explore, ensuring every couple finds their perfect match. From classic solitaires to intricate halo designs, the possibilities are endless. With expert guidance at every step, ALUXE helps bring dream rings to life, crafting one-of-a-kind masterpieces that truly reflect each couple’s journey.

Beyond design, the experience itself is seamless. ALUXE’s consultants provide warm, personalised guidance, making every step of the process enjoyable and stress-free. Their expertise extends beyond diamonds, so whether couples need proposal tips or jewellery care advice, ALUXE is there to assist.

### Custom-Crafted Brilliance: The ALUXE Diamond Advantage

![Image 7: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153707_85083.jpg)

Whether you are looking for a natural diamond or a lab-grown diamond, ALUXE's dedication to quality, transparency, and innovation ensures that you find the perfect one. Not all diamonds are created equal, and ALUXE makes no compromises when it comes to quality. Every diamond in its collection is graded D to F in colour — the purest, most colorless standard—so each stone radiates unparalleled brilliance.

And for those who want the perfect balance of quality and convenience, ALUXE’s **Instant Diamond Selection** ensures a hassle-free experience. With real-time access to over 30,000 diamonds, customers can select their ideal piece with confidence, viewing every detail through a 360° high-resolution display. A direct connection with suppliers guarantees diamonds are always in stock, with transparent pricing updated in real time — no hidden mark-ups, just the best value for the best diamonds. Those in a hurry can choose from a wide range of ready-to-go options and walk away with their dream piece the same day, while pre-orders are guaranteed for delivery within two months.

ALUXE’s commitment to **competitive pricing without compromise** ensures that luxury remains accessible. By sourcing directly from the world’s leading diamond-cutting factories, ALUXE eliminates unnecessary middlemen and passes those savings directly to customers. As one of Taiwan’s largest diamond importers, ALUXE has the power to negotiate unbeatable prices, offering some of the best diamond prices in Singapore. Whether it’s a first-time purchase or an addition to a growing collection, customers receive the highest quality at the most competitive price.

### Certified Excellence & Distinctive Elegance

![Image 8: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153744_77354.jpg)

Every ALUXE diamond is backed by internationally recognised certification. Natural diamonds are GIA-certified, ensuring authenticity, ethical sourcing, and precise grading of cut, colour, clarity, and carat weight. Lab-grown diamonds come with IGI certification, guaranteeing the same brilliance and quality. But ALUXE goes even further. By introducing the Ultimate Diamond, ALUXE sets a new benchmark in excellence. Using advanced diamond technology, these gems undergo scientific evaluation for brilliance, fire, scintillation, and optical symmetry — ensuring they are not just beautiful, but truly exceptional.

![Image 9: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153802_30916.jpg)

For those seeking something beyond the ordinary, ALUXE offers an extensive range of fancy-cut diamonds and rare coloured diamonds, including pink, yellow, and blue hues.

![Image 10: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153824_10135.jpg)

![Image 11: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153832_22860.jpg)

The **ROSÉ My Love collection** makes the dream of pink diamonds more attainable by pairing lab-grown pink diamonds with expert craftsmanship, offering unparalleled beauty at a price within reach. ### Grand Copthorne Waterfront Hotel Singapore presents Serendipity by the Waterfront Wedding Showcase

Step into a world of romance and inspiration at **Serendipity by the Waterfront**, the exclusive wedding showcase at Grand Copthorne Waterfront Hotel Singapore. Join us on 12 April, from 12:00 pm to 5:00 pm, for an unforgettable experience filled with elegance, creativity, and love.

At this one-of-a-kind event, couples can:

*   **Talk to our dedicated team of wedding specialists**to plan every detail with confidence 
*   **Explore our stunning wedding venues**, from intimate spaces to grand waterfront ballrooms 
*   **Experience a culinary showcase**featuring exquisite tasting menus 
*   **Learn more about our dedicated Wedding Butler service**, designed to ensure your day is flawless from start to finish 

 Discover everything you need to craft your dream wedding: 
*   **Musical Touch**– enchanting live music to set the perfect mood 
*   **Yvonne's Creative Bridal Couture** – exquisite gowns for your special day 
*   **Aluxe Jewellery**– dazzling pieces to complete your bridal look 
*   **Eternal Red Bonds** – honouring cherished Chinese wedding traditions 
*   **Scent37**– signature perfume stations for personalised scents 
*   **60Shutter Photography & Videography** – capturing every precious moment 
*   **Gnomes Florist –** stunning floral arrangements to elevate your celebration 

### Exclusive Fair Promotions

Confirm your plans at the show and enjoy**sure-win instant prizes**, including **cash rebates**and a **1ct lab-grown diamond**, plus more surprises to make your wedding planning journey even sweeter.

 Whether you’re envisioning a classic ceremony by the water or a modern celebration filled with charm, **Serendipity by the Waterfront**is your gateway to inspiration, creativity, and everything you need to bring your dream wedding to life.

# How Early Should You Book Vendors in Singapore?

 2026-01-18

![Image 5: How Early Should You Book Vendors in Singapore?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20260219/20260219142401_98977.jpg)

_Source:[@‌cherryywongg](https://www.instagram.com/cherryywongg)_

Securing quality wedding vendors in Singapore requires strategic timing. Book too early, and you're committing before you've refined your vision. Wait too long, and your preferred vendors are unavailable, leaving you with second-choice options or premium last-minute rates. Here's your guide to booking vendors at the optimal time.

### Venues: 12 to 18 Months in Advance

Your venue is the linchpin of your entire wedding. It determines your date, influences your theme, and often provides or restricts your vendor options. In Singapore's competitive wedding market, popular venues book remarkably early.

Hotel ballrooms, iconic locations like Fort Canning Park or Sentosa venues, and boutique spaces with limited capacity often fill up 12 to 18 months ahead, particularly for peak wedding months (March, May, September, and December) and auspicious dates according to the Chinese lunar calendar.

Weekend dates disappear fastest. If you're set on a Saturday evening in May 2026, start searching now. However, if you're flexible (considering Friday evenings, Sunday afternoons, or weekday celebrations), you'll find better availability and often significantly lower prices.

Some venues offer better rates for off-peak dates or newly opened spaces looking to build portfolios. These can be excellent opportunities if timing aligns with your plans.

### Photographers and Videographers: 12 to 15 Months Ahead

Quality visual documentation of your wedding deserves early attention. Talented photographers and videographers in Singapore often book 12 to 15 months in advance, sometimes earlier for particularly sought-after professionals or popular dates.

Why such long lead times? Skilled photographers typically limit how many weddings they accept monthly to ensure quality and avoid burnout. They might only take two or three weddings per weekend, meaning once those slots fill, they're fully booked regardless of when you enquire.

Start researching photography styles early. Understand whether you prefer photojournalistic, traditional, artistic, or editorial approaches. Review full wedding galleries, not just highlight reels. You want to ensure consistency throughout the day.

Once you've identified photographers whose style resonates with you, reach out to check availability for your date. Many photographers will hold dates with a deposit, which secures your booking whilst you finalise other details.

### Wedding Planners: 10 to 15 Months Before

If you're hiring a wedding planner, do this relatively early, ideally before or just after booking your venue. Planners help with vendor recommendations, timeline creation, and budget management, so engaging them early maximises their value.

Planners come in different service levels: full-service (managing everything from concept to execution), partial planning (coordinating specific elements or taking over mid-planning), or day-of coordination (ensuring smooth execution of your plans).

Many couples initially plan to DIY everything, then hire planners months later when overwhelmed. If you know you'll want support, engage a planner early rather than bringing them in when you're already stressed and behind schedule.

### Caterers: 9 to 12 Months in Advance

If your venue doesn't provide catering, or you're hosting at a location that allows external caterers, book this essential vendor about nine to twelve months out. Popular caterers fill up quickly, particularly those known for specific cuisines or dietary specialisations.

In Singapore, many hotel venues include catering in packages, so your timeline matches your venue booking. For external catering, ensure your caterer has experience with your specific venue. Some locations have restrictions on equipment, setup times, or menu elements that affect what's feasible.

Schedule tasting sessions once you've narrowed caterer choices. These typically occur three to six months before your wedding, allowing time to finalise menu selections based on what you've sampled.

![Image 6: How Early Should You Book Vendors in Singapore?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20260203/20260203130234_78292.jpg)

_Source: thesynchronal_

### Makeup Artists and Hair Stylists: 9 to 12 Months Ahead

Bridal makeup artists and hairstylists who are skilled with various looks (traditional Chinese bridal, natural makeup, editorial glamour) book well in advance. In Singapore's tight-knit wedding industry, talented professionals are often recommended within vendor networks, meaning they maintain full schedules.

Book your makeup artist around nine to twelve months before your wedding, then schedule trials two to three months ahead. Trials let you test looks, adjust preferences, and ensure you're comfortable with your artist's style before the actual day.

If you're having multiple outfit changes (tea ceremony dress to wedding gown to evening qipao), discuss this during booking. Some artists charge per look or per outfit change, whilst others include a certain number of changes in their package.

### Florists and Stylists: 6 to 9 Months Before

Floral designers and wedding stylists typically have more availability than photographers or venues, but popular professionals still book six to nine months ahead. Flowers also require advance planning because certain blooms are seasonal or need to be ordered from overseas suppliers.

When booking florists, bring inspiration images but remain flexible. Singapore's tropical climate affects flower availability and longevity. Some dreamy Pinterest flowers simply won't survive outdoor humidity or air-conditioned ballrooms. Trust your florist's expertise on what works practically whilst achieving your aesthetic vision.

Discuss budget parameters honestly. Florals can range from a few thousand dollars for simple arrangements to $15,000 or more for elaborate installations. Your florist can create options at various price points if they understand your limits from the beginning.

### Entertainment: 6 to 9 Months Ahead

Live bands, DJs, and traditional performers book up relatively far in advance, particularly for peak wedding season. Budget six to nine months ahead to secure quality entertainment that matches your celebration style.

If you're hiring a live band, watch them perform before booking if possible. Many bands have showcase events or perform at other venues where you can assess their sound, energy, and professionalism firsthand.

For DJs, discuss music preferences, special requests, and emcee duties if they're managing reception flow. Some couples provide detailed playlists, whilst others trust their DJ's expertise. Clarify your preference during booking conversations.

### Invitations and Stationery: 4 to 6 Months Before

![Image 7: How Early Should You Book Vendors in Singapore?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20260203/20260203130739_88528.jpg)

_Source: Pexels_

Custom invitation design takes time, particularly if you're working with a designer on bespoke elements. Start conversations four to six months before your wedding to allow for design rounds, printing, and addressing.

If you're ordering ready-made designs or using online services, you can start slightly later, around three to four months out. However, remember that invitations should mail approximately two to three months before your wedding, so work backwards from that deadline.

Allow time for proofreading. Typos in printed invitations are expensive to fix, so have multiple people review before finalising print orders.

### Wedding Favours and Rentals: 3 to 4 Months Out

Items like wedding favours, specialty rentals (vintage furniture, unusual serving pieces, custom signage), and reception décor elements can be secured three to four months before your wedding. This gives vendors adequate production or sourcing time without committing too early.

For custom or personalised favours (monogrammed items, custom biscuits, or speciality products), confirm production timelines with vendors. Some items require four to six weeks minimum for customisation and production.

### Transportation: 2 to 3 Months Ahead

Wedding day transportation (bridal cars, guest shuttles, or speciality vehicles) should be booked two to three months in advance. Singapore has numerous options from classic cars to luxury vehicles, and availability tightens closer to your date.

Confirm pickup and drop-off locations, timing, and any special requirements (champagne service, specific routes, photo stop locations) when booking. Ensure your transport provider knows your actual timeline. The last thing you need is a car arriving early whilst you're still getting ready, or late when you're meant to depart for your ceremony.

### What If You're Planning on a Shorter Timeline?

Sometimes circumstances require faster planning: job relocations, family situations, or simply wanting to marry sooner rather than later. You can absolutely plan a beautiful wedding in three to six months, but expect some compromises.

With shorter timelines, approach vendors understanding they may be booked or charge premium rates for last-minute availability. Be flexible on dates. Weekday weddings or off-peak months often have better vendor availability. Consider smaller guest counts, which opens more venue options.

Some vendors specialise in shorter-timeline weddings or maintain availability for smaller celebrations. Don't assume you can't book quality vendors quickly. Reach out and ask rather than eliminating options without checking.

### The Bottom Line on Booking Strategy

Start with your venue, as this determines your date and influences other vendor choices. Immediately after securing your venue, book photography and videography. From there, work through vendors in roughly the order outlined above, adjusting based on your specific priorities.

Throughout this process, trust your instincts. If a vendor feels wrong (communication is poor, their style doesn't quite match, or something feels off), keep searching. You're trusting these professionals with crucial elements of your celebration, so genuine confidence in your choices matters more than checking boxes on a timeline.

Finally, remember that vendor relationships work both ways. Professional, responsive communication from you (replying to emails promptly, respecting their time, being clear about expectations) helps vendors deliver their best work. The strongest vendor relationships are partnerships built on mutual respect, clear communication, and shared investment in creating your beautiful celebration.

# Glasshouse Venues in Singapore (Wedding & Event Guide)

 2026-01-21

![Image 5: Glasshouse Venues in Singapore (Wedding & Event Guide)](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20260127/20260127112951_34893.jpg)

_Credit: Blissful Brides_

So, you've scrolled through hundreds of wedding photos and noticed something: the ones that make you stop mid-scroll usually feature floor-to-ceiling glass, natural light flooding in, and greenery visible just beyond the walls. You're not imagining it. Glasshouse venues photograph remarkably well, and Singapore has a growing collection of them scattered across the island.

But here's the thing nobody tells you: not all glasshouse venues work for all weddings. Guest count, location, and even the time of day you're planning your celebration will dramatically affect whether a particular venue delivers what you're hoping for.

## What Makes Glasshouse Venues Different in Singapore

### What defines a glasshouse venue?

A true glasshouse venue features fully enclosed glass structures with floor-to-ceiling windows on at least two or three sides. They're air-conditioned, weather-protected, and specifically designed to maximise natural daylight and views of surrounding greenery or cityscapes. This sets them apart from covered outdoor venues or conservatories, which often lack climate control.

### Why do glasshouse venues photograph well?

The answer comes down to light. Natural daylight diffuses through glass walls, creating soft illumination that flatters skin tones without harsh shadows. Your photographer won't need to rely heavily on flash, and the clean architectural lines of glass and steel frames create modern, uncluttered backdrops. If the venue looks out onto gardens or city skylines, you get depth and visual interest in every shot without needing elaborate décor.

### How do glasshouse venues compare to other venue types?

Against traditional hotel ballrooms, glasshouse venues offer significantly more visual impact and a sense of occasion. There's no mistaking a glass pavilion overlooking Marina Bay for a conference room that doubles as an event space on weekends. Compared to fully outdoor venues, glasshouses provide the aesthetic appeal of being surrounded by nature while eliminating Singapore's two biggest weather variables: unpredictable rain and oppressive humidity. You get the garden-party atmosphere without guests fanning themselves with the ceremony programme.

## How to Choose a Glasshouse Venue in Singapore

### What factors matter most?

Start with capacity. Glasshouse venues in Singapore range from intimate spaces seating 30 guests to larger venues accommodating 280 or more. The venue's layout also affects practical guest capacity, as some spaces suit round-table banquets while others work better for theatre-style seating or standing cocktails.

Location matters for your guests' convenience. A venue in the central business district is easily reached by MRT, while a venue at Seletar or Sentosa requires more travel planning. Consider whether your guest list skews towards driving or public transport.

Finally, think about timing. Glasshouse venues transform dramatically between day and night. A lunch celebration bathes everything in natural light, while evening events show off city lights and create a different mood entirely.

### What factors are often overlooked?

Heat and glare management catch couples off-guard. Even air-conditioned glass structures can develop hot spots when the afternoon sun beats directly onto certain walls. Ask whether the venue has tinting, blinds, or strategic positioning that minimises this.

Acoustic reflection is another consideration. Glass surfaces bounce sound, which can create echoey conditions that affect speeches and background music. Venues with soft furnishings, drapes, or acoustic panels handle this better.

 Setup and teardown timing also varies widely. Some venues allow full-day access, while others operate tight changeover windows that limit how elaborate your décor can be.

## Glasshouse Venues by Event Type Suitability

### Which glasshouse venues suit weddings best?

For solemnisation ceremonies, smaller glasshouse venues create intimate atmospheres where your guests feel genuinely close to the moment. Wheeler's Estate Greenhouse in Seletar works beautifully for this, with its fairy-tale aesthetic and surrounding greenery. The Glasshouse at Lazarus Island offers something completely different, requiring a 15-minute ferry ride from Sentosa Cove that turns your ceremony into an adventure.

For wedding dinners, mid-sized venues like The Pavilion at Conrad Centennial Singapore (seating up to 140 guests) or The

Garden Studio at Andaz Singapore (up to 100 guests) balance visual impact with practical hosting needs. These venues offer enough space for proper round-table dining while maintaining the intimacy that makes glasshouse settings special.

Design-focused celebrations suit 1-Atico, perched 55 storeys above ION Orchard. The panoramic city views provide such a dramatic backdrop that minimal additional décor is needed.

### Which glasshouse venues suit corporate or private events?

Product launches benefit from The Glasshouse at Andaz Singapore, which accommodates up to 280 guests with its 6-metre-high ceiling and glass box design. The modern aesthetic photographs well for press coverage and social media.

Brand activations work well at Flower Field Hall in Gardens by the Bay's Flower Dome, where the surrounding floral displays provide built-in visual interest that reinforces brand storytelling. The venue handles up to 700 guests and includes programmable LED lighting.

Private parties find a sweet spot at venues like Sky Garden Sentosa, which combines an outdoor garden area with an air-conditioned indoor glasshouse seating up to 120.

## Glasshouse Venues by Capacity

### Small glasshouse venues (30–60 guests)

These intimate spaces work best for solemnisation ceremonies, proposal events, or extremely close-knit celebrations. Options include:

*   **Angsana Glasshouse at Faber Peak:**70 seated, 100 standing, with panoramic sea and garden views 
*   **The Glasshouse at Lazarus Island:** 60 seated for round-table banquets, accessible by ferry from Sentosa Cove 
*   **Garden Domes at Botanico/The Summerhouse:**Intimate clear-walled structures set within landscaped grounds in Seletar 

These venues typically offer limited staging and AV flexibility, so they're better suited for simple, heartfelt ceremonies than elaborate productions.

### Medium glasshouse venues (60–120 guests)

This is the most common format for wedding dinners in Singapore. The size allows proper round-table seating while preserving the personal atmosphere that makes glasshouse venues appealing. Options include:

*   **The Garden Studio at Andaz Singapore:** Up to 100 guests, adjoins an outdoor terrace with city views 
*   **The Pavilion at Conrad Centennial Singapore:**Up to 140 guests, glass-enclosed with pool views and Marina Bay skyline 
*   **Sky Garden Sentosa:** Up to 120 guests indoor, with rooftop and poolside options 
*   **Wheeler's Estate (various spaces):** The al-fresco café accommodates up to 115 guests; The Verandah handles slightly more 

These venues balance aesthetics with guest comfort reasonably well, though you'll want to confirm seating configurations during site visits.

### Large glasshouse venues (120–200+ guests)

Larger glasshouse venues remain rare in Singapore because glass architecture becomes challenging at scale. The options that exist tend to be hotel-integrated or purpose-built event spaces:

*   **The Glasshouse at Andaz Singapore:**Up to 280 guests banquet-style, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows on three sides with rose-gold metal partitions 
*   **1-Atico at ION Orchard:**100–242 guests, with 180-degree skyline views from the 55th floor 
*   **Artemis Grill:**150 seated guests in the main dining hall, 40th floor of CapitaGreen 
*   **Flower Field Hall at Gardens by the Bay:**Up to 700 guests, the largest true glasshouse option in Singapore 

Larger venues typically come with higher costs and stricter vendor rules. They may require you to use in-house catering or select from approved vendor lists.

## Glasshouse Venues by Location in Singapore

### Central and city glasshouse venues

Venues in the CBD and Orchard area offer high accessibility via MRT, making them practical for guests coming from across the island. They also suit weekday events and corporate functions where attendees may be coming directly from work.

*   **1-Atico:**55th floor of ION Orchard, directly above Orchard MRT 
*   **Artemis Grill:** Level 40 of CapitaGreen, near Tanjong Pagar MRT 
*   **Andaz Singapore:**Connected to Bugis MRT 

The trade-off is usually higher rental costs and less greenery, though city skyline views compensate for the latter.

### Garden and park-integrated glasshouse venues

These venues prioritise greenery and natural surroundings, creating stronger visual connections to nature. They're typically located further from central Singapore and require travel planning.

*   **Wheeler's Estate:** Seletar Aerospace, 2-acre grounds with colonial bungalow and greenhouse 
*   **Botanico at The Summerhouse:**Also in Seletar, garden domes amid landscaped grounds 
*   **Gardens by the Bay (Flower Field Hall):**Within the Flower Dome conservatory, Marina Bay area 
*   **The Glasshouse at Lazarus Island:**Southern Islands, ferry access from Sentosa Cove 

Do factor in transport arrangements for elderly guests or those unfamiliar with the locations.

### Rooftop glasshouse venues

Rooftop venues combine glass architecture with elevated city or sea views, creating dramatic settings that shift beautifully from day to night.

*   **1-Atico:**55 storeys above Orchard Road 
*   **SKAI at Swissôtel The Stamford:**Level 70, contemporary grill with floor-to-ceiling windows 
*   **Sky Garden Sentosa:**Rooftop of iFly Singapore, overlooking the South China Sea 

Consider glare and heat with rooftop venues, particularly for daytime events facing west. Operational limitations may also apply, including noise restrictions and setup constraints.

## Questions to Ask Before Booking a Glasshouse Venue

### What should couples and planners confirm?

Air-conditioning performance tops the list. Ask specifically about cooling capacity during afternoon events and whether the venue has experienced heat issues at certain times of year or day. Request to visit during a similar time slot to your planned event.

Rain and heat contingency plans matter even for indoor venues. Will backup lighting be provided if an overcast day affects natural light? What happens if the adjacent outdoor space you were planning to use becomes unavailable?

Vendor and décor restrictions vary significantly. Some venues mandate in-house catering, others allow external caterers from approved lists, and a few offer complete flexibility. Similarly, confirm whether suspended decorations, candles, or confetti are permitted, as glass venues sometimes have strict rules about these.

Setup and teardown timing affects how elaborate your styling can be. Confirm exactly when your decorators can access the space and when everything must be cleared.

## Choosing the Right Glasshouse Venue

### Who should choose a glasshouse venue?

Couples prioritising photography will find glasshouse venues deliver consistently impressive results. The natural light, clean architectural lines, and visible greenery or city backdrops reduce dependence on elaborate décor or heavy post-production editing.

Hosts planning intimate, design-led events benefit from the inherent visual interest of glass architecture. With the right venue, the structure itself becomes a feature, allowing you to keep additional styling minimal and focused.

### Who should avoid glasshouse venues?

Large guest counts above 300 become challenging, as few Singapore venues offer glasshouse aesthetics at that scale without moving to convention-style spaces.

Loud, entertainment-heavy programmes may conflict with acoustic limitations and venue noise restrictions. If your celebration centres on a live band, extensive dancing, or high-energy performances, confirm sound levels are permissible and that the space handles amplified music well.

Ultimately, the right glasshouse venue matches your guest count, location preferences, and aesthetic vision while handling

Singapore's climate realities. Visit during similar conditions to your planned event, ask pointed questions about the practical details, and you'll find a space that photographs beautifully while keeping everyone comfortable.

# Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?

 2025-05-23

![Image 5: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164407_82763.jpg)

When planning your wedding, you’d want to make sure everything is perfect, from the seating chart to the music playlist and every detail in between. It's one of the biggest days of your life, so it’s only natural to want to be thorough and get down to the nitty-gritty of what needs to be sorted.

But are all these details truly essential, or are some simply unnecessary pressures passed down through generations or social media? Let’s take a closer look at some common wedding planning myths and, more importantly, what really deserves a spot on your[wedding planning checklist in Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/wedding-tools "Wedding Planning Checklist, Wedding Planning Checklist Singapore").

### Myth 1: You Need a Grand Guest List

![Image 6: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164504_34523.jpg)

There’s a long-standing belief that weddings must include everyone you know: your childhood neighbours, distant cousins, former classmates, and your parents’ colleagues. While it may seem polite to cast a wide net, a large guest list doesn’t necessarily mean a better celebration.

In fact, many couples in Singapore are now embracing the idea of smaller, more intimate weddings. These gatherings not only allow for more meaningful interactions with each guest, but they also help keep costs manageable. A compact guest list can free up your budget for things you genuinely care about, such as a stunning venue or a great photographer.

**Checklist Tip:**Think about the people who matter most to you and your partner. Instead of feeling obligated to invite everyone, create a guest list that feels right for you. This will also help you make better decisions when it comes to catering, seating, and venue size.

### Myth 2: You Must Follow Every Wedding Tradition

![Image 7: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164606_27183.jpg)

From cake cutting to tossing the bouquet, traditional wedding customs are often treated as must-haves. But the truth is, many couples today are skipping these rituals in favour of more personal touches.

Don’t like the idea of a first dance? Skip it. Prefer an unconventional walk down the aisle song? Go for it. Whether it’s the type of ceremony, your outfit, or the reception format, there’s no rule that says you have to follow any specific formula. In multicultural Singapore, couples often mix different customs or invent their own, and that’s part of what makes each celebration unique.

Even during [wedding dress shopping](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/wedding-dress-shopping-101-expert-advice-for-brides-to-be "Wedding Dress Shopping 101: Expert Advice for Brides-to-Be"), some brides choose coloured gowns or opt out of traditional silhouettes entirely. The focus is on what makes you feel beautiful and confident, not what fits a centuries-old standard.

**Checklist Tip:**When going through your checklist, consider what traditions you and your partner value and which ones you can let go of. Replace outdated expectations with experiences that reflect your personalities and relationship.

### Myth 3: You Must Have a Perfect Plan for Every Detail

![Image 8: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164704_85503.jpg)

It's tempting to believe that if you plan everything down to the second, your wedding day will go off without a hitch. But weddings, like life, are full of unpredictable moments. The truth is, no matter how detailed your schedule is, something small may go wrong on the day itself. And that’s completely okay.

You might forget the rings at the hotel, or a guest might arrive late. It might drizzle during your outdoor ceremony. These little mishaps are normal, and many become funny or touching memories in hindsight. What’s important is that you and your partner are celebrating your love with the people who care about you.

Instead of striving for a flawless event, aim for a meaningful one. Have a basic timeline, communicate clearly with your vendors, and assign a reliable point-of-contact for the day. But beyond that, give yourself permission to enjoy the moment without sweating every detail.

**Checklist Tip:**Your wedding planning checklist should include essentials like confirming your venue, hiring key vendors, and arranging transportation. But also include flexibility by allowing space for changes and focusing on what will make the day feel special, not perfect.

### What Matters Most on Your Big Day

![Image 9: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164828_19434.jpg)

Wedding planning can feel overwhelming, especially with so many opinions, traditions, and myths floating around. But once you filter out what doesn’t serve you, you’ll find it much easier to focus on what really matters.

Your wedding day should reflect your love story, your personality, and your priorities, not someone else’s idea of what’s “right.” Whether you're going all out or keeping things simple, it’s the connection between you and your partner that truly makes it unforgettable.

# An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day

 2022-11-24

![Image 5: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102243_76662.jpg)

For all the true romantics at heart, your wedding ceremony is one of the most precious once-in-a-lifetime events to be treasured. Surrounded by your closest friends and loved ones, everyone wishes for their wedding to be perfect and memorable for years to come.

However, at the same time, it can be deeply stressful and anxiety-inducing planning for such a grand event — especially when you helmed the majority of the preparations alone like what influencer Joanna Soh did.

Between balancing her full-time job, a burgeoning social media presence, and hectic wedding planning all on her plate, how exactly did Joanna manage this feat? What did she love and regret the most about her wedding? And more importantly, what guidance can she glean regarding all things proposal, wedding prep, and relationship advice?

In this exclusive interview, Joanna candidly shared with us her best ‘big sister' tips to avoid the mistakes she did and slay your wedding day instead.

![Image 6: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102316_56275.jpg)

### A little background on Joanna

Compared to the average working adult, Joanna’s day-to-day life is everything but ordinary. While dedicated to her job as a full-time account manager at 99.Co, you can also find her busily capturing Insta-worthy moments to share with her 70,000 followers.

Take one glance at her social media profile and you’d think she’s the typical lifestyle or beauty influencer. However, there’s more than meets the eye.

Admittedly, she got her start from posting beauty- and fashion-related content when younger, but her content has since matured alongside her. Besides sharing good deals and the occasional foodie recommendation, we can now expect more snippets of her domestic and household life.

![Image 7: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102405_14717.jpg)

### Pre-wedding and day-of wedding obstacles faced

### #1 Self-planning a wedding

For starters, planning any major event from scratch is a huge undertaking — let alone a grand-scaled affair like wedding banquets. There are so many logistical concerns that’ll leave any untrained person feeling overwhelmed.

Initially, Joanna felt confident that she’d manage to cover all the bases for her wedding. It was only after she enlisted the help of an event planner (her friend’s sister) that she realised how many minute details had been missed out.

Although she settled the basics like the wedding gown and suit fittings, the small details like wedding favours/door gifts were accidentally forgotten. They got pushed down by the floods of daily emails received in her inbox.

While these mistakes were never intentional, they do slip our minds quite easily. Even when she was assisted by her friends here and there, nothing compared to the capabilities of a professional.

Things like compiling the guestlist, curating to perfect banquet menu, and selecting an appropriate theme and decor — there are just simply too many things on the wedding checklist. Not to mention, all these need to fall under your budget too.

Apart from the wedding prep itself, there are other pre-wedding businesses to attend to, like your pre-wedding photoshoot.

Moreover, [every wedding planner has their niche](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/top-5-reasons-to-hire-a-wedding-planner-for-your-big-day); some specialise in [destination weddings](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/how-do-you-know-if-destination-weddings-are-for-you), whereas others specialise in month-of or day-of coordinating. It really depends on what sort of help you need.
