### #2 Menstrual hormonal acne

Ladies, whenever we hear the words “menstruation” and “hormonal acne”, we know they never bode well. If anything, that time of the month usually spells painful cramps, hormonal imbalances, skin breakouts, and emotions on edge all balled up into one.

And it’s one of the last things any blushing bride would want on her wedding day. Unfortunately, our menstrual cycle can’t exactly be predicted so far (like, one year) in advance throughout the wedding planning process.

In Joanna’s case, she was one of the unlucky few whose cycle coincided with the big day. As a result, she had an unwelcome visitor — a huge, painfully swollen pimple — right before her wedding day. It was so sore that she could barely lift a smile!

Needless to say, this sent her into an immediate frenzy and full-on panic mode. She frantically contacted her wedding makeup artist for advice, but regardless, it was a tough predicament.

Joanna tried all sorts of remedies as recommended by Google: from cold and warm compresses to pimple cream and stickers, but it was all for nought.

Ultimately, because she was pressed for time, she made her way down to her long-time aesthetic clinic, Clifford Clinic, as a last resort. At the clinic, they assessed her pimple condition and administered a S$150 acne jab [Cortisone Shot for Acne] as treatment.

At first, there wasn’t any noticeable change in the swelling. But after a couple of hours sleep, the miracle that Joanna prayed for came true and her pimple completely disappeared almost like magic. Even her makeup artist was astounded!

To Joanna, this S$150 spent was completely justifiable in exchange for rescuing her face in time. Whereas for others, it might not be worth it. Regardless of which you agree with, you have to agree that desperate times do call for desperate measures.

![Image 8: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102617_69899.jpg)

### #3 Slimming down before the wedding

It’s only normal for every bride-to-be to want to look her best for the wedding day, with weight loss or looking slim at the forefront of their mind. Although there are multiple approaches to losing fat in a healthy and consistent manner, here’s Joanna’s golden tip.

Two words, portion control.

As we’re sure most health experts would agree, weight loss is 20% exercise and 80% diet. What we put into our bodies is more impactful than the energy exerted.

Thus, although exercise wasn’t Joanna’s cup of tea, her discipline and consistency in her diet portions allowed her to stay on track with her weight goals. She didn’t need to restrict herself from her favourite foods (e.g. KFC), but limiting the quantity intake made all the difference.

In total, she managed to lose a total of 4.5kg before her actual wedding day.

**Fun fact:**Joanna and her fiance contracted COVID-19 two weeks before the wedding. This inadvertently caused their appetite to shrink a little, and ironically helped them work towards their weight goals despite being sick. Talk about a silver lining behind every cloud!

### #4 Not getting enough sleep

As with any pre-event jitters, falling asleep the night before might be a struggle. Despite taking sleep support pills* as well, Joanna and her husband were only able to sleep for 30 minutes.

Similarly to one’s menstrual cycle, this was not something that could be controlled. You can do your best to follow all the general sleep recommendations, but if your mind is active and full of nerves, sleep just won’t come naturally.

The best tips are just to “sleep earlier” and “avoid using electronics right before bedtime”, remarked Joanna.

*Not to be confused with sleeping pills. This sleep support pill helps to generate melatonin to induce deeper sleep more quickly.

![Image 9: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102734_69512.jpg)
### #5 Slight miscommunication over alcohol package

Of course, no merrymaking is complete without the accompaniment of alcohol. Once the booze is out, the good times roll naturally — or at least that’s what Joanna had in mind.

Prior to the wedding, Joanna actually asked the event manager twice regarding the hotel wedding package’s alcohol policy. Ostensibly, they were given a choice between free-flow beer or wine, of which, they chose the latter. Furthermore, they were told that no pre-event alcohol was allowed and that only regular beverages could be served.

Because of that, she was under the pretence that the wine would only start serving after the wedding solemnisation at around 7.30pm or 8.30pm. But then, that didn’t exactly go according to plan.

As it turns out, Joanna’s wedding guests were actually served the 28 complimentary bottles of wine (one per table) during the solemnisation itself; so much so that during the first course of the banquet, she was notified that all the wine had finished even though the feasting just began.

Flustered, they hurriedly forked out over S$400 more to purchase six more bottles of wine. If she had continued ordering more rounds, this extra alcohol cost would accumulate quickly and burst their wedding budget tremendously.

In hindsight, Joanna reflected that better clarity could’ve been communicated between hotel and newlyweds. And if the package permits a BYO (bring-your-own) alcohol policy, she highly recommends young couples take advantage of it!

![Image 10: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102956_14343.jpg)

### Bonus: Tips for proposals

It’s common knowledge by now but Singapore is not the cheapest city to live in — and wedding proposals are no exception! But between splurging on meaningful milestones and saving for your future together, where do we draw the line?

Luckily, Joanna has a few takeaways to share with us after her (very romantic) yacht proposal.

### #1 Use your best friends as a distraction

When you’re with your spouse 24/7, it’s very hard to keep secrets from them. They see and know your every move, making it nearly impossible to liaise with any vendors for a proposal. So what’s the solution here?

Rope your best friends into the act!

Not only is this the least suspicious method, but your friends can double up as a decoy to make it seem like you’re the one planning their proposal.

In Joanna’s case, her best friend had just purchased a resale flat back then. This meant that her best friend would need to legalise her marriage as soon as possible to secure the unit. One thing led to another and this acted as the perfect ruse for planning Joanna’s proposal in plain sight!

**Fun fact:** Get your friends to bring a nice, pre-planned outfit so at least the bride-to-be gets to look good during the surprise proposal.

### #2 Consider an overseas proposal

You’ve heard about destination weddings, but why not destination proposals? Since booking venues in Singapore can cost a pretty penny, planning your proposal overseas could potentially be both cheaper and offer a nicer scenery.

Because let’s face it, in terms of landscapes, Singapore is fairly limited for choice; unless you opt for a yacht proposal like Joanna’s fiance did, then that’s a different story.

![Image 11: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124103200_56988.jpg)

### #3 Always double-check the rules/restrictions of the proposal venue

Singapore is notorious for rules, regulations, and imposing fines. The last thing you’d want is to be penalised for a gorgeous 800-balloon display because it breaches venue restrictions like safety distancing (back at the height of COVID-19).

For your wallet’s sake, Joanna advises it’s better to be safer than sorry.

### #4 Reuse the proposal decor for your wedding decor

Another ingenious tip that Joanna recommends is to not be afraid to re-use your proposal decor for your wedding if the theme fits! Every dollar counts, so why not make your money’s worth by re-purposing your proposal props and decor to elevate your wedding location?

This decision could be the crucial difference between abiding by your budget or breaking the bank.

![Image 12: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124103410_53921.jpg)

### Final thoughts

Last but not least, a wedding is the closing of one chapter, and the opening of another. It marks the first milestone to the rest of your forever together with your spouse.

Although weddings involve external parties and families, just remember that at the end of the day, your wedding is a sacred union between the two of you. Prioritise instead, on building a strong foundation of trust and mutual understanding in order to foster healthy communication and compromises within nuptial constraints.

Known for the heart and effort that goes into their truly personalised bespoke approach to engagement rings, GIOIA Fine Jewellery stands out as well for their wide selection of precious gemstones available for each interested client who comes searching for that perfect gem.

Each gemstone, from the unheated royal blue sapphire to the rare Brazilian Paraiba tourmaline, offers a palette of unique shades and shapes, allowing couples to create their one-of-a-kind ring with personal significance and style. Unlike the standard diamond of a traditional engagement ring, these coloured gems provide a distinctive, personalised touch that reflects the individuality of each relationship, and these unique gems are currently increasing in demand and exceptionally rare.

### Experience a Journey from the Moment You Enter

From the moment you step into one of their boutiques, the adventure begins, filled with discovery and excitement. With the aim of ensuring that the process of creating your unique ring should be as joyful and memorable as the final piece itself, gain invaluable insights into the beauty and significance of each stone with the guidance of GIOIA’s helpful and experienced experts who will ensure you have a deep understanding of the gems that resonate with your story and values.

You’ll be able to take ownership of the process of bringing your dream ring to life in a shared journey with GIOIA. Together, you'll experience the thrill of selecting the perfect gem, discussing design ideas, and witnessing the transformation of these elements into a symbol of your love. This anticipation adds a special dimension to the experience, making the wait for the final piece as enjoyable as the unveiling itself.

### Entrust Your Design to GIOIA’s Team of Experts

GIOIA's expertise in custom-designed pieces ensures that every ring tells a unique love story, with rarity and timeless elegance. Whether it's incorporating a beloved pet into the design or selecting a gem that resonates on a personal level.

The value of the rings is not just for your own engagement! Unlike lower-quality rings that may tarnish and diminish in value over time, GIOIA promises to craft you heirloom-quality jewellery that stands apart in both beauty and meaning, standing the test of time and keeping your memories of a lifetime preserved for your descendants as well.

With GIOIA, you can be sure that you will be getting the engagement ring that best suits you while fitting the dream design that you may have in mind. Here are some reasons why you can have faith in GIOIA and their pieces.

# Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-02-20

Vendor:[Mount Faber Peak](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/306/mount-faber-peak)

![Image 5: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124420_82536.jpg)

When it comes to wedding venues that truly elevate the experience — literally and figuratively — **Mount Faber Peak** stands in a league of its own.

With panoramic views that stretch over the harbour and Sentosa Island, this hilltop haven is a dream come true for couples seeking a wedding venue that feels both unique and intimate. Blissful Brides is proud to honour Mount Faber Peak with our coveted Editor’s Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venue, and here’s why it deserves a place on your shortlist.

### Versatile Venues for Every Celebration

![Image 6: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124443_89321.jpg)

Mount Faber Peak offers a selection of exquisite venues that cater to every type of celebration, from intimate receptions to grand gatherings. For those dreaming of a cosy yet sophisticated affair, the **Angsana Glasshouse** provides an ethereal setting. Surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass windows, this crystalline space is perfect for up to 70 guests. Its elevated location at the highest point of Mount Faber ensures awe-inspiring views of the HarbourFront and beyond.

![Image 7: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124458_56770.jpg)

For larger celebrations, **The****Ballroom** is nothing short of breathtaking. With its floor-to-ceiling glass windows and sophisticated design, it comfortably accommodates up to 200 guests. The venue’s unique charm lies in its view of the iconic cable car cabins gliding against a backdrop of shimmering waters. Guests can even begin the festivities with a stylish cocktail reception at the veranda or bar, setting the tone for an unforgettable evening.

![Image 8: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124515_82856.jpg)

For couples who dream of an outdoor ceremony surrounded by nature, the **Arbora Garden** offers a picturesque setting like no other. This lush hilltop garden, adorned with heritage Angsana trees and whimsical landscaping, is the ideal spot for exchanging vows under the open sky. The centrepiece of the garden, Poland’s Bells of Happiness, adds a touch of enchantment and tradition, inviting couples to ring in good fortune for their new chapter together.

### Simply Unforgettable Experiences

![Image 9: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124537_58988.jpg)

Mount Faber Peak is all about creating magical moments, and it all begins with a breathtaking first impression! Couples can make a dramatic entrance via the stunning spiral staircase that leads to Arbora Garden for their solemnisation, setting the stage for a day brimming with elegance and romance. Guests will also have a blast arriving in style by cable car rides, adding an extra layer of excitement and uniqueness to the event!

### A Setting Like No Other

![Image 10: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124605_47310.jpg)

Beyond the venues themselves, Mount Faber Peak’s hilltop location offers something few others can match: an escape from the city’s hustle without straying too far from its conveniences. Just minutes from downtown Singapore, this hidden gem provides a serene retreat with panoramic views, lush greenery, and a sophisticated atmosphere. It’s a place where nature meets modern luxury, creating the perfect backdrop for unforgettable celebrations.

### Award-Winning Excellence @ The Peak

With its slogan “Celebrate Love @ The Peak,” Mount Faber Peak encapsulates everything a wedding venue should be — romantic, versatile, and utterly breathtaking. Just imagine exchanging vows or hosting a reception where every corner reveals a new picture-perfect scene.

It’s no wonder, then, that Mount Faber Peak has earned our Editor’s Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venue. From its charming spaces to its spectacular views and unique offerings, every element is designed to make your wedding day truly extraordinary. For couples looking to start their forever on a high note, **Mount Faber Peak** is the venue that delivers on every promise.

# Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-02-20

Vendor:[Mount Faber Peak](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/306/mount-faber-peak)

![Image 5: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124420_82536.jpg)

When it comes to wedding venues that truly elevate the experience — literally and figuratively — **Mount Faber Peak** stands in a league of its own.

With panoramic views that stretch over the harbour and Sentosa Island, this hilltop haven is a dream come true for couples seeking a wedding venue that feels both unique and intimate. Blissful Brides is proud to honour Mount Faber Peak with our coveted Editor’s Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venue, and here’s why it deserves a place on your shortlist.

### Versatile Venues for Every Celebration

![Image 6: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124443_89321.jpg)

Mount Faber Peak offers a selection of exquisite venues that cater to every type of celebration, from intimate receptions to grand gatherings. For those dreaming of a cosy yet sophisticated affair, the **Angsana Glasshouse** provides an ethereal setting. Surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass windows, this crystalline space is perfect for up to 70 guests. Its elevated location at the highest point of Mount Faber ensures awe-inspiring views of the HarbourFront and beyond.

![Image 7: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124458_56770.jpg)

For larger celebrations, **The****Ballroom** is nothing short of breathtaking. With its floor-to-ceiling glass windows and sophisticated design, it comfortably accommodates up to 200 guests. The venue’s unique charm lies in its view of the iconic cable car cabins gliding against a backdrop of shimmering waters. Guests can even begin the festivities with a stylish cocktail reception at the veranda or bar, setting the tone for an unforgettable evening.

![Image 8: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124515_82856.jpg)

For couples who dream of an outdoor ceremony surrounded by nature, the **Arbora Garden** offers a picturesque setting like no other. This lush hilltop garden, adorned with heritage Angsana trees and whimsical landscaping, is the ideal spot for exchanging vows under the open sky. The centrepiece of the garden, Poland’s Bells of Happiness, adds a touch of enchantment and tradition, inviting couples to ring in good fortune for their new chapter together.

### Simply Unforgettable Experiences

![Image 9: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124537_58988.jpg)

Mount Faber Peak is all about creating magical moments, and it all begins with a breathtaking first impression! Couples can make a dramatic entrance via the stunning spiral staircase that leads to Arbora Garden for their solemnisation, setting the stage for a day brimming with elegance and romance. Guests will also have a blast arriving in style by cable car rides, adding an extra layer of excitement and uniqueness to the event!

### A Setting Like No Other

![Image 10: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124605_47310.jpg)

Beyond the venues themselves, Mount Faber Peak’s hilltop location offers something few others can match: an escape from the city’s hustle without straying too far from its conveniences. Just minutes from downtown Singapore, this hidden gem provides a serene retreat with panoramic views, lush greenery, and a sophisticated atmosphere. It’s a place where nature meets modern luxury, creating the perfect backdrop for unforgettable celebrations.

### Award-Winning Excellence @ The Peak

With its slogan “Celebrate Love @ The Peak,” Mount Faber Peak encapsulates everything a wedding venue should be — romantic, versatile, and utterly breathtaking. Just imagine exchanging vows or hosting a reception where every corner reveals a new picture-perfect scene.

It’s no wonder, then, that Mount Faber Peak has earned our Editor’s Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venue. From its charming spaces to its spectacular views and unique offerings, every element is designed to make your wedding day truly extraordinary. For couples looking to start their forever on a high note, **Mount Faber Peak** is the venue that delivers on every promise.

Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website.  Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can.

# Say “Yes” to These Gowns by My Dream Wedding

 2022-05-23

![Image 5: Say “Yes” to These Gowns by My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20220524/20220524190446_66084.jpg)

Search for bridal gowns on popular social media app Xiao Hong Shu (“Little Red Book”) and you’ll see My Dream Wedding topping the list. Here’s why.

Originally hailed from Hong Kong, My Dream Wedding is known for its large selection of modern chic gowns, Korean-themed photography and global photojournalism expertise. Today, the bridal house has successfully opened multiple boutiques in the region across Singapore, Malaysia, Macau and China – a testament to being a trusty wedding atelier to many brides-to-be.

If you’re getting hitched and have started the hunt for a wedding gown that has to scream “the One”, My Dream Wedding might just have it. This bridal boutique has dresses with various necklines, silhouettes, colours and fabric that will leave you spoilt for choice.

### A Dress For Every Woman

![Image 6: Say “Yes” to These Gowns by My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20220524/20220524190517_22349.jpg)

Let’s be honest, one of the most exciting things about weddings is shopping for the wedding dress. With so many bridal shops planted across the island to choose from, My Dream Wedding stands out for fashionable gowns and designer collections. Their passionate team of gown experts know that every bride-to-be is going to be the star of the night, and they’re ready to make her look like one.

My Dream Wedding serves a comprehensive collection of gowns to suit different body sizes, personality and preferences. They have timeless ballgowns for those who want a hint of drama, satin A-line dresses that prioritise comfort and elegance, lacy trumpet gowns that elongate the legs and silky sheath pieces that show off the hour-glass.

With so many gorgeous dresses to try on, you and your bride crew are definitely going to have a girly-good time at My Dream Wedding.

### Ethereal Evenings

![Image 7: Say “Yes” to These Gowns by My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20220524/20220524190617_37096.jpg)

Let’s talk about the importance of evening gowns. It’s true that guests will keep their eyes peeled as you make your grand entrance in that perfect white dress, but did you know that it is the evening gown that leaves the longest impression?

Evening gowns are the ones you’ll be wearing for the rest of the celebration and the one that you take photos with. Most importantly, you’ll be wearing it as you bid goodbye to guests at the end of the night.

Thankfully, My Dream Wedding has an array of princess-inspired evening gowns that will leave guests in awe. Intricately laced with rhinestones and lace, these A-line tulle silhouettes also come in majestic shades of mauve-rose, pastel grey with periwinkle blue and deep royal sapphire.

### The Importance Of Craftsmanship

![Image 8: Say “Yes” to These Gowns by My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20220524/20220524190647_19724.jpg)

My Dream Wedding prides itself in delivering sophisticated and trendy gowns that don’t skimp on quality and comfort. Their in-house team of fashion experts are committed to ensuring that their dresses are sewn to perfection and able to exude the charm of every bride.

Just as Vera Wang once said, “I want people to see the dress, but focus on the woman”. My Dream Wedding aims to do just that.

### One-Stop Bridal Boutique

![Image 9: Say “Yes” to These Gowns by My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20220524/20220524190817_66935.jpg)

Apart from wedding gowns, My Dream Wedding continues to impress newlyweds every year with their professional photography services too. They offer both local and popular overseas photoshoot destinations that include Hong Kong, Korea, Paris and Iceland. Along with their trusted and leading partners across the globe, My Dream Wedding facilitates cross-border arrangements to achieve astounding photos against ever-changing landscapes.

Weddings are a special celebration and more than just a ceremony. The team at My Dream Wedding believes that every union is unique and deserving of a customised service from start to end of the wedding planning journey. So don’t be shy, and come say yes to the dress at My Dream Wedding.
